name: supply-checkout
description: Shared supply checkout projects with barcode and receipt scanning, built as a static web bundle.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:demo && npm run build:ops && npm run build:site
scripts.lint: eslint . && node scripts/check-links.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/validate-html.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test:ops && npm run check:public && npm run check:regions && npm run test:scripts && npm test
scripts.test:scripts: shellcheck scripts/*.sh && bash scripts/land-pr.test.sh && bash scripts/beads-pr.test.sh && bash scripts/deploy.test.sh && bash scripts/deploy-diff.test.sh && node --test scripts/publish-web.test.mjs scripts/deploy-stacks.test.mjs scripts/check-replacements.test.mjs scripts/check-environments.test.mjs scripts/deploy-github-deploy.test.mjs scripts/deploy-journeys.test.mjs scripts/check-workflow-environments.test.mjs scripts/check-web.test.mjs scripts/smoke-checks.test.mjs scripts/ops.test.mjs scripts/operators.test.mjs scripts/restore-drill.test.mjs scripts/check-stray-files.test.mjs scripts/backlog-page.test.mjs scripts/backlog-stop-hook.test.mjs scripts/journeys.test.mjs scripts/journey-videos/journey-videos.test.mjs scripts/journey-videos/marketing.test.mjs scripts/journey-videos/report.test.mjs scripts/npm-audit.test.mjs scripts/journeys/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.publish:demo: npm run build:demo && node scripts/publish-web.mjs publish --channel demo --dir dist/demo
scripts.publish:site: npm run build:site && node scripts/publish-web.mjs publish --channel site --dir dist/site
scripts.publish:ops: npm run build:ops && node scripts/publish-web.mjs publish --channel ops --dir dist/ops
